en: Black‑and‑white postcard view over a tree‑filled square with paths and people walking, surrounded by ornate late‑19th‑century multi‑storey buildings. A large, richly decorated corner building dominates the center background, and church or town‑hall‑like spires rise above the skyline. The scene looks down a main street running along the right side of the square. Printed caption text appears in Swedish at the bottom left.
